contentText: PRESS REVIEW – Tuesday, February 17: It's been one year since the Trump administration dismantled USAID, the agency for international development. The press looks at how South Africa, a country which relied on US aid, is faring and the impact it has had on HIV/AIDS prevention. Also, the EU's climate advisory board says Europe should prepare for a three-degree increase in temperatures by the end of the century. Plus: the Olympics' curling scandal plays out in the Swedish and Canadian press.
